# Catalog & Navigation Quality Checklist: ระบบเมนูหลักและการจัดการสินค้าและหมวดหมู่

**Purpose**: Unit tests for requirements quality, clarity, and completeness of the Navigation & Product Catalog specification
**Created**: 2026-10-21
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are all user roles (`ADMIN`, `MANAGER`, `CASHIER`) and their specific navigation permissions explicitly defined? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, §FR-001a]
- [x] CHK002 Are all mandatory and optional fields for product creation documented with boundary rules? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008]
- [x] CHK003 Are the visual properties and fields of the product table columns comprehensively listed? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004]
- [x] CHK004 Is the pagination behavior and available page-size options specified for the product table? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007]
- [x] CHK005 Are requirements specified for internal barcode generation rules and formats? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009]
- [x] CHK006 Are allowed image file formats and maximum upload size limits documented in requirements? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK007 Is the behavior of the Collapsible Sidebar clearly quantified for desktop vs touchscreen devices? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001, §FR-002]
- [x] CHK008 Is the currency conversion between Backend Satang (integer) and UI Baht (decimal) explicitly defined? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004, Plan §Summary]
- [x] CHK009 Are search criteria and debounce timing thresholds quantified? [Clarity, Spec §SC-003, Plan §Summary]
- [x] CHK010 Is the distinction between `PRICE_PER_UNIT` and `BY_WEIGHT` product types clearly documented? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008, Data Model §2]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK011 Do the role-based visibility rules align consistently between the Sidebar and Route Protection? [Consistency, Spec §FR-001, §FR-001a]
- [x] CHK012 Are category deletion constraints consistent between category management and product dependencies? [Consistency, Spec §FR-014, Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK013 Are product status states (Active/Inactive) consistent across table filter and POS visibility? [Consistency, Spec §FR-006, §FR-011]

## Scenario & Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK014 Are fallback image/placeholder requirements specified when a product lacks an uploaded photo? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 5]
- [x] CHK015 Are safe deletion and deactivation recommendation requirements specified for products with sales history? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-012]
- [x] CHK016 Are requirements defined for duplicate SKU or Barcode conflicts? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK017 Are empty search result states defined with clear user recovery actions? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Non-Functional & Security Requirements

- [x] CHK018 Are page transition and search response time performance targets testable and measurable? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001, §SC-003]
- [x] CHK019 Are language and localization requirements aligned with the project constitution for 100% Thai UI? [Consistency, Constitution §2, Spec §SC-005]
- [x] CHK020 Are error notification and client-side validation messages specified to be user-friendly without exposing internal system details? [Security, Spec §FR-016]
